University: Shahjalal University of Science and Technology, Southeast University
Idea Title: PoraBondhu AI: An AI Reading Diagnostician for Early-Grade Bangla Reading
Assessment: Grapheme-level Bangla reading diagnosis using LM-free CTC so children's errors are kept, with a Whisper baseline and teacher-in-the-loop; strongest technical depth and clear national evidence (NSA 2022). Risk: annotated child-speech data in a short build.

University: Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET)
Idea Title: SkinAI Bangladesh
Assessment: Offline Bangla skin triage for community clinics with own BD-trained model, warning-sign rules, abstain-when-unsure and Upazila doctor confirmation; very well-grounded workflow. Reuses an earlier model, which must be disclosed.

Idea Title: AdhikarAI (অধিকারAI): Bangla Voice Assistant for Government Services and Citizens' Rights
Assessment: Voice-first Bangla + dialect normalisation + cited RAG over official land/GD/allowance/labour documents with honest 333 fallback; high social value, AI is the core.

Idea Title: Mobile Money Scam Shield
Assessment: Checks the payment itself (fake bKash screenshots, pre-transfer scam scripts) plus a scam-trainer role-play; precise, honest, Bangla/Banglish, realistic day-by-day plan.

Idea Title: Prohori: An Agentic AI Sentinel for Autonomous Vulnerability Exposure Analysis and Bounded Remediation
Assessment: Agentic vulnerability-exposure analyst: osquery daemons, OSV/CISA KEV matching on exact distro builds, AI reasoning and bounded, approved remediation. Highly original; scope is ambitious for the hackathon window.

Idea Title: MyLaws: Plain-Language Legal Assistant & Formal Complaint Drafter
Assessment: Banglish legal triage grounded in 1,046 gazette sections with a deterministic citation validator and Bangla A4 PDF drafting of GD/labour/consumer complaints; live app already exists.

Idea Title: HaorWatch AI: Intelligent Flood Detection and Agricultural Impact Assessment for Bangladesh's Haor Regions
Assessment: Custom model segments floods from Sentinel-1 SAR and overlays ESA WorldCover to estimate farmland exposure in haor regions, with Bangla summaries; real ML, honest scope.

Idea Title: AuraSign
Assessment: Two-way Bangla Sign Language translator on a plain webcam (MediaPipe landmarks + classifier, speech-to-sign avatar) for clinics; strong accessibility case. BdSL vocabulary coverage is the main risk.

University: Chittagong University of Engineering and technology
Idea Title: Amar Dokan (আমার দোকান): AI Business Assistant for Small Retailers
Assessment: Bangla/Banglish voice bookkeeping for small shops: LLM to strict JSON with confirmation, deterministic money/stock maths, demand forecast and budget-aware restocking; well-scoped with measurable metrics.

Idea Title: Roza-Safe: safer Ramadan fasting for people with diabetes
Assessment: Ramadan fasting copilot for diabetics: IDF-DAR risk score as rules, iftar plate photo to glycaemic-load curve, pre-iftar safety check; very local and safety-conscious (solo team).

Idea Title: Medi Waypoint
Assessment: FHIR-native platform joining a Bangla voice triage agent with a tracked referral loop across health tiers; excellent problem analysis, but a very large scope for the build window.

Idea Title: FairPrice BD: Explainable Food Price Anomaly Detection and Supply-Chain Intelligence for Bangladesh
Assessment: Explainable food-price anomaly detection (forecast + uncertainty + residual anomalies + SHAP, leakage-safe evaluation); rigorous ML, depends on aligned public data being available.

Idea Title: AgroLeaf AI — AI-Powered Rice Leaf Disease Screening for Bangladeshi Farmers
Assessment: Rice-leaf disease screening with own model trained from scratch, calibrated confidence with an 'I am not sure' option, Bangla cards with no pesticide doses; careful and responsible. Template placeholders were left unfilled.

Idea Title: ScamShield BD: বাংলা ভাষায় AI-চালিত অনলাইন প্রতারণা শনাক্তকারী সিস্টেম
Assessment: Multi-layer Bangla scam detector (rules + template similarity + community reports + LLM) for messages, links and screenshots; solid and feasible, overlaps with other scam entries (solo team).

Idea Title: CircularShield: AI-Powered Recruitment Fraud Detection and Verification Platform
Assessment: Fake job-circular detection with OCR, fine-tuned BanglaBERT, rule engine and verified-organisation lookup, explained in Bangla; relevant to students, dataset is the main risk.

Idea Title: Shoi : An Privacy Preserving Bangla AI Voice Chat Assistant For Menstrual Health and Mental Wellness Among Rural Womens
Assessment: Anonymous Bangla voice assistant for menstrual and mental health of rural women with a PCOS risk model and cycle tracking; high impact, but clinical-safety and auto-999 escalation need care.

Idea Title: Dokan AI
Assessment: Turns messy Facebook seller captions into a structured catalogue and builds budget-safe outfit bundles with a deterministic solver; good separation of LLM vs logic.

Idea Title: FarmMarket – AI-Powered Fair-Price Marketplace and Agricultural Intelligence Platform
Assessment: Working bilingual farm marketplace with explainable matching, price forecasting, RAG assistant, OR-Tools routing and traceability; broad and honest about limits, AI is spread thin across many modules.

Idea Title: FloodSathi AI
Assessment: Bangla/English flood-report triage: embedding-based category/urgency, duplicate detection and coordinator map with human verification; focused and feasible.

Idea Title: An AI-Powered Connected Healthcare Platform
Assessment: Already-built multi-portal health platform (64 checks passing) adding a Claude chatbot, OCR and reminders; strong execution, less novel as an idea.

Idea Title: IELTSai
Assessment: Fully offline IELTS mock tests with a local Qwen/Whisper/Piper speaking and writing examiner; working prototype, less tied to local problems.

Idea Title: MediDiary
Assessment: Offline voice health diary: on-device Whisper + Qwen3-0.6B extraction with user review and clinician PDF export; privacy-first and careful, modest impact.

University: BAIUST, Daffodil International University, Manarat International university
Idea Title: DocMate AI: A Personal AI Assistant for Doctors Guiding Accurate Treatment and the Right Medicine
Assessment: Closed-library RAG clinical assistant for doctors with claim verification and rule-based drug-safety checks; well thought through, but high-risk clinical scope and a heavy data burden.

Idea Title: BonnaBondhu AI: An Intelligent, Bangla-First Disaster Preparedness and Emergency Assistance Platform
Assessment: Bangla RAG assistant for flood and cyclone preparedness with checklists and source citations; sound but generic, and team details were left blank.

University: United International university, united international university, United International University
Idea Title: AquaCycle AI – An Intelligent Floating Waste Detection, Collection and Segregation System.
Assessment: YOLO-driven floating waste detection with ESP32 collection and sorting; tangible hardware demo, but feasibility in the build window is the main risk.

Idea Title: CampusFix: AI-Powered Campus Issue Reporting and Tracking
Assessment: Campus issue reporting with vision-LLM categorisation, embedding de-duplication and priority scoring; tight 5-hour plan, narrower impact.

University: Shahjalal University of Science and Technology
Idea Title: KRISHI AI
Assessment: Bangla voice-first leaf disease and nutrient-deficiency app with an expert-reviewed remedy base; useful but a common idea and the recognition model is unspecified.

University: Bangladesh University of Business and Technology
Idea Title: Centralized medical profiling
Assessment: Central patient timeline with report extraction (Qwen2.5-VL) plus cited hospital-facility search; reasonable, but a common concept and a broad build.

University: Bangladesh Army International University Of Science And Technology (BAIUST)
Idea Title: LifeLine AI – Intelligent Emergency Response System
Assessment: Gemini-based emergency report classification with a severity map and admin dashboard; solid scope, mostly an API wrapper.

Idea Title: Neurova, the first AI health intelligence that hears, remembers, and listens.
Assessment: Offline Bangla maternal-health companion (prescription/report reading, nutrition, reminders); important need, but the document is marketing-heavy and the technical plan is thin.
